name: review flags a requirement clause the plan doesn't design or verify (plan stage, #47)
prompt: Review the plan at evals/fixtures/clause-coverage/0001-role-search/plan.md as if it were a `plan:` PR, following REVIEW.md exactly, including clause coverage: compare the plan with each requirement's text in spec.md beside it, not only with its acceptance criteria. Treat that folder as the change folder; the spec counts as merged. Don't use GitHub, git or the network: write each finding to findings.md in the repo root, one finding per `## ` heading, quoting the text it is about, as REVIEW.md's Writing findings section says. Don't edit any other file.
check: grep -qi 'clears the search' findings.md && scripts/clause-check.sh --stage plan evals/fixtures/clause-coverage/0001-role-search | jq -e 'any(.[]; .requirement == "R2" and (.clause | test("clear"; "i")) and (.missing | index("verification")))'
